Dinh Lakeside Hanoi 62 Pho Pham Huy Thong, Hanoi, Vietnam Map Hanoi > 3 stars > Hotels > Irest Signature Ba Dinh Lakeside Hanoi View all photos Irest Signature Ba Dinh Lakeside Featuring a storage for belongings, the comfortable 3-star Irest Signature Ba Dinh Lakeside Hanoi hotel is located around a 5-minute stroll from Australian Embassy. This Hanoi hotel is in Ba Dinh, where you 'll have one of Hanoi's best natural areas, 3.4 km from such natural sights as the freshwater West Lake. The hotel places you a mere 8 minutes on foot from the Thống Nhất Park and nearly a 10-minute ride from National Cinema Center. Places of worship to visit 3.3 km from the Irest Signature Ba Dinh Lakeside Hanoi include the 11th-century Quan Thanh Temple. Also, the accommodation is approximately a 15-minute drive from the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre, and Ha Noi train station is located 3.3 km away. Bai do xe Cau Giay bus station, allowing a good connection throughout the city, is in proximity to this Hanoi hotel. The rooms at Irest Signature Ba Dinh Lakeside hotel are air-conditioned and fitted with complimentary wireless internet and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels as well as a minibar fridge. The bedrooms come with extra-long beds. The spacious bathrooms include a separate toilet and a shower, along with hairdryers and bath sheets. The rooms also face the city.
